file_formats.analysis.md: Markdown format summarizing ads per prompt requirements
file_formats.ads_data.csv: CSV with headers filename,copy_text,cta_text,theme,format and one row per ad
file_formats.ad_*.png: PNG images of ads with filenames matching ad_XXX.png pattern

content_requirements: Markdown analysis must include total ad count matching number of PNG ads extracted
Markdown should mention pain points, themes with percentages, creative patterns (3 or more), CTA patterns, and recommendations
CSV must contain all ads with correct columns and match counts
Folders named lowercase with hyphens as specified
